title: 1801 Prairie's bowed bay and paired windows, from its photograph
items: The Kimball house at 1801 Prairie gains the bowed bay J. W. Taylor photographed in the middle of its front: two storeys, a broad transomed window on each, its cornice wrapped round the bow and a stone balcony on top.
The south pavilion's windows become the photograph's mullioned and transomed pairs, one a storey.
The carving round them, the frieze over the principal storey and the loggia's carving are still plain stone, and come next.
